content.text: {"core": "Compassion feels what another feels and moves toward them. In Nurturing, it works on the tending that helps something grow — feeding, warming, staying close as it forms. Overdone, the feeding never stops: the growing thing is held so constantly it never has to stand on its own, and the care becomes the thing that keeps it small.", "sheetLine": "The feeding never stops; what is held this closely never learns to stand."}
